title: Ideal coefficient samples under reindexing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^{[n]}\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $P\subseteq[n]$, and fix a sign assignment $z:P\to\{-1,1\}$. Let $k$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\delta\leq1/2$, and let the input batch consist of free-coordinate sign assignments indexed by the restricted sample count for $(P,k,\delta)$. For every frequency $S$ among the subsets of free coordinates of size at most $\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, the batch of reindexed labeled samples obtained by restricting $f$ at $z$ agrees pointwise with the pairs consisting of each corresponding reindexed input and the value of the reindexed restricted function at that input.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
the input batch is indexed by the restricted sample count
$S$ belongs to the low-degree family on the free coordinates
